summary: Rabbi Soffer examines Rashi's commentary on Parashat Lech Lecha in Beresheet, focusing on HaKadosh Baruch Hu's covenant with Avraham Avinu and the misva of Berit Mila. He explores the gematria of adding a letter Hey to Avraham's name to equal 248 limbs, referencing discussions in Masekhet Nedarim and the Ben Ish Hai. The class also addresses the significance of living in Eretz Yisrael according to Masekhet Ketubot and the details of Berit Mila obligations.
subjects: Name changes of Avram and Sarai
questions: Why was a letter added to Avram's name to turn it into Avraham?
Why did Avraham Avinu fall on his face when Hashem spoke to him before his Berit Mila?
How does Berit Mila assist a person in controlling their senses and Yetser Hara?
How does Masekhet Ketubot view a person living outside Eretz Yisrael?
Who is liable for Karet if a person remains uncircumcised?
